responsibility: This module contains the shared documentation-build infrastructure for GNAT Ada manuals, centered on Sphinx configuration, formatting support, and Ada-specific syntax highlighting rather than compiler front-end semantics. Its main files define the common Sphinx build entry point that selects document sets, derives version and variant metadata, configures extensions and output formats, and manages HTML, LaTeX, and Texinfo publication settings; provide reusable LaTeX fragments and macros used to typeset PDF manuals consistently; and supply custom Pygments lexers for Ada source, tagged Ada snippets, and GNAT project files so documentation can accurately highlight language and project syntax. Together, these files make gcc/ada/doc the module responsible for assembling and styling GNAT documentation outputs across manual variants.
